Ten extracted original-function/class controls confirm these findings under explicit type/error/memory adapters. None is promoted to complete public image pipeline evidence.
Source Windows platform uses Windows integer types; Apple explicitly rejected. Visual Studio2013/v120 Win32 Debug/Release project only. No original platform or release binary built.

vnProfile.h sets VN_PARAM_CHECK=1 in debug,0otherwise. Earlier null/zero rejection controls explicitly enabled checks and do not qualify normal Release validation. Authored status values differ from original bitmask status scheme; actual arithmetic/byte findings are scoped to adapters.

DCT UINT8 loops can wrap for count>=256; accepted thumb settings can request that count. Invalid shifts, unchecked dimension arithmetic, copy/raw constructor initialization and failure cleanup concerns remain source-only; unsafe paths not executed.

Image factory leaves allocated object on SetFormat/SetDimension failure. Clone compares destination pointer target before creating. Actual caller initialization/allocation failure behavior unqualified.
Public vnCompareImages uses256bitstreams and ReadBit, not internal64bit comparator or unalignedReadByte. Whole image hash quality and documented scale/rotation invariance not established.
No upstream tests, image fixtures or CI present in22trackedartifacts; README describes RGB8buffer use only, no decoder implementation.
